title: nan
authors: Li Z.; Zhao C.; Wang J.; Hou X.; Hu J.; Pan Q.; Jia C.
key_contribution: Presents a UAV system with multi-sensor SLAM and A*/3DVFH+ local path planning for autonomous navigation and reconstruction in GNSS-denied environments, with comprehensive experiments.
